name: @french-castle/skill-scanner
description: Scan Agent Skills for prompt injection, hidden instructions, exfiltration, and remote code before Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, or npx skills installs them. Standalone and offline by default; TypeSafe's jev is an optional second opinion.
